metrics.context: c1b_joint (rank 4 = rank 16 on the cabinet key, exploratory) and q27_joint (pre-registered) were read before this

hypotheses.H1: kept > zero-shot pooled over the 30 arrivals (exact sign test)
hypotheses.H2: the final primitive > zero-shot pooled over all arrivals (consolidation keeps earlier arrivals' gains)

metrics.reported: demonstrations requested per key and in all (of 30 arrivals), primitives stored (4.7 MB each), per-arrival success
metrics.rule: per key, arrivals in order: the key's current primitive (if any) vs the policy on init states 0-9, 10 episodes, noise seed 8; kept if MORE successes; else the arrival requests its one demonstration, which joins the key's library, the key's primitive is refit on all its demonstrations (c0_fit --joint, rank 4, 1000 steps) and tried again against the same zero-shot episodes; kept if more successes
metrics.test: c2_main: each arrival's kept arm, zero-shot and the key's FINAL primitive on init states 30-49, 20 episodes, seed 8
metrics.written_before: any episode or fit of c2_stream
